summary: A representative muscular artery: flattened endothelial cells, thin connective support, fenestrated elastic boundaries, circumferential smooth muscle and fibrous adventitia. The specimen combines macro-calibrated wall proportions with enlarged sampled microstructure.
scale_note: Macro calibration: 1 model unit = 2.6 mm. Cell, nuclear, fibre, wall-vessel and neural representatives are enlarged and sparsely sampled; they do not share a verified uniform enlargement or literal density. IEL/EEL apertures are sparse enlarged teaching examples. The legacy 20x rat experimental pore prior is not human pore morphometry; the calibrated ruler is not a microscopic scale bar.

comparisons.question: Where does the load-bearing elastic material sit?
comparisons.answer: Muscular artery: prominent inner elastic boundary around a smooth-muscle-rich media. Elastic artery: repeated elastic lamellae throughout media with muscle between them; boundary laminae are less distinct.
comparisons.function: Use this structural contrast to distinguish blood distribution/tone from proximal pulse buffering. Both vessel types contain muscle and elastin.
comparisons.scale_rule: Related model has its own macro calibration; compare tissue organization, not same-screen apparent caliber.

comparisons.question: What differs for a comparably sized vein?
comparisons.answer: Veins generally have a thinner media and a relatively large lumen; some have intimal valves. Adventitial support can be prominent.
comparisons.function: Compare the muscular pressure-bearing artery with venous return and valve directionality where the related model represents valves.
comparisons.scale_rule: Do not infer universal venous valve presence or a population-normal wall ratio from these representative models.

native_limitations: Native named-camera metadata saves camera, hidden keys, assembled state and cut_on; it does not save sections, opacity, ghost state, depth or explode. Runtime adapter must be installed explicitly on an isolated ModelView to apply full progression.
Native ModelView starts bulk tissue opacity at 50%; the explicit controller restores 100% for tissue identity views.
mixed_schematic_scale is applied to native viewer sidecar by the runtime controller to suppress misleading per-part macro size summaries. Generic ruler remains macro-calibrated.
Camera targets and section positions are source-grounded starting proposals; final saved geometry framing requires native roundtrip and manual visual review on separate machine.
